description: This file implements MD5-HMAC cryptographic functions for the Linux kernel, including context management, key setting, transformation, and final hash computation, specifically optimized for Infineon hardware.

methods.name: md5_hmac_transform
methods.description: Saves input block to the context, handling workaround for large data blocks.

methods.name: md5_hmac_setkey
methods.description: Sets the MD5 HMAC key, handling keys longer than 64 bytes.

methods.name: md5_hmac_setkey_hw
methods.description: Loads the MD5 HMAC key into hardware registers.

methods.name: md5_hmac_init
methods.description: Initializes the MD5 HMAC context before processing.

methods.name: md5_hmac_update
methods.description: Performs on-the-fly MD5 HMAC computation with input data.

methods.name: md5_hmac_final
methods.description: Finalizes the MD5 HMAC computation, producing the hash output.

methods.name: md5_hmac_final_impl
methods.description: Computes the final or intermediate MD5 HMAC value, interacting with hardware.

methods.name: md5_hmac_init_tfm
methods.description: Initializes pointers in the MD5 HMAC context for kernel crypto.

methods.name: md5_hmac_exit_tfm
methods.description: Frees allocated resources in the MD5 HMAC context.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_md5_hmac
methods.description: Registers the MD5 HMAC driver with the kernel crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_md5_hmac
methods.description: Unregisters the MD5 HMAC driver from the kernel crypto API.
